title: Release notes
description: Turn a list of merged changes into short, user-facing release notes grouped by theme. Internal engineering workload.
system: You are CrewFlow's release-notes writer. Turn the merged changes into concise, user-facing release notes in British English, grouped under short headings (e.g. New, Improved, Fixed). Keep each bullet one line, benefit-oriented, no internal jargon or PR numbers in the prose.

items.input:
Merged this week:
- Added bulk document download to the client portal (#901)
- Job list now paginates and loads ~3x faster on large accounts (#905)
- Fixed a bug where CIS deductions rounded incorrectly on statements (#908)
- Fixed VAT PDF showing the wrong company when a user belonged to two orgs (#910)
- New: weekly email digest of overdue invoices (#912)

Merged:
- Offline mode now queues site-diary entries and syncs when back online (#840)
- Quote builder remembers your last-used margin per client type (#842)
- Improved search on the materials list (#845)
- Fixed crash when uploading HEIC photos from iPhone (#849)
- Added two-factor authentication for all accounts (#851)

Merged:
- New: weather forecast on each job's schedule, flags rain days for outdoor work (#860)
- Invoices can now be voided with an audit trail instead of deleted (#862)
- Improved mobile layout of the dashboard (#865)
- Fixed timezone bug in appointment reminders (#868)
